context: Request: how many of the firm's credit facilities are covenant-lite in the market sense (institutional term loans with no always-on financial maintenance covenant), and which ones, for a lender update. Rubric: 1005-00001 (Nexford TLB) and 1021-00001 (Verimark TLB) qualify, plus a precision criterion. 1001-00007, 1003-00003 and 1041-00003 (term loans with springing or no covenants documented in the Financing folders of other deal matters) are outside the permitted set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a find of the top two directory levels and file-type counts. The stage_start note suggested folder listing or file-name search; the declared label fits the work. The review asks for the full folder count and content searches.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts and lists all 266 matter folders.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex over all files for credit, loan and covenant words in parallel with a content grep that returns nothing; labelled by the file-name search. The review flags substring noise and the empty grep.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: grouped, uncapped path sweep; 110 hit matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 3: supplementary path sweep with more financing words; 70 matters. The review flags common words.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 4: writes the union of path-hit matters (139) to a file.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out after writing a partial hit file; counts hits per matter, greps the file for exact phrases (about 115K characters) and prints sections. A mid-stage protocol check queries a file-size call. The review flags the partial scan and the narrow phrase filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: extraction in four matter-range batches over the saved candidate list, then a filtered grep of the per-matter summary; a stage_start for screening is refused because this stage is still open. The review flags unverified coverage and the head cap.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads credit agreements, term sheets, memos and commitment letters from about a dozen candidate matters in two parallel batches, then snippet scripts on covenant sections of the leading agreements. The review flags about 60 surfaced matters never opened and unreconciled engagement numbers.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five facilities as qualifying, with exclusions. The review asks to check each against its executed agreement.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and re-extracts covenant passages; no edits.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: extracts one agreement's covenant section and edits the citation for that facility.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: re-extracts the same covenant section to confirm a threshold.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 4: path-existence check and a re-read of the response opening.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 5: checks the output file for the threshold and the five matter numbers; every review asks to leave the population unchanged.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It counted three term loans documented in the Financing folders of other deal matters as part of the firm's credit book, alongside the two qualifying facilities.

first_error.critic_note: The reviews asked only for fact and path checks and told the agent to keep the population unchanged unless a source contradicted it; none questioned whether the extra facilities belonged in the set.
first_error.why: The answer lists five facilities as covenant-lite, three of them acquisition-financing term loans read in other deal matters' Financing folders, which the request's credit book did not cover (evidence seen at [70]-[101]).

first_error.why: Its snippet script printed long windows around a greedy pattern over whole-document text with only a line cap, and the oversized result, after earlier multi-hundred-thousand-character scan outputs, filled the context before any answer was written.

runs.failure_point: It counted two term loans documented in the Financing folders of other deal matters as part of the firm's credit book, alongside the two qualifying facilities.

first_error.critic_note: Reviews asked to confirm amounts and covenant text and repeatedly said not to add or remove matters; none questioned whether the two extra facilities belonged in the set.
first_error.why: The answer lists four facilities, two of them acquisition-financing term loans read in other deal matters' Financing folders, which the request's credit book did not cover (evidence seen at [34]-[60]).

divergence: All three runs failed. T0 and T2 wrote both qualifying facilities but added term loans from the Financing folders of other deal matters (three and two), with the reviews checking facts only and telling the agent to keep the set unchanged; the error sits at the write stage. T1 never wrote an answer: after flooded scan outputs, a snippet script over named agreements overflowed the context during screening.
